dct_description_sm:
This is geographic information system (GIS) data for an OMAFRA-funded project examining relationships between landscape variability and wheat yield response to Plant Growth Regulator. It can be opened and analyzed using freely available software such as Quantum GIS. Treatment was a Plant Growth Regulator on winter wheat (Moddus PGR) applied early spring according to product label. 
-Control was unsprayed
-Single strip (unreplicated)
-Location shifted to preserve privacy; the farms appear to be part of Johnston Green at the University of Guelph main campus.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: On-farm data for wheat yield response to plant growth regulator
